rootCollections.faces: Exactly 1,993 authoritative workbook rows, one per census face key.
rootCollections.runtimeBindings: Current canonical-filename Backend execution contracts, normalized by runtime ID. Complete stored contracts are included without semantic rewriting.
rootCollections.canonicalFaceGroups: Runtime aliases grouped only by stored registration assetSha256.

faceSections.identity: Census identity, registered face resolution, aliases, product/SKU and runtime bindings.
faceSections.existingUnderstanding: Only classifications, structures, and treatment data already stored in the workbook, QT authority, or linked contracts.
faceSections.authority: Publisher/governing, physical/face, SCZN3-derived, and runtime provenance boundaries.
faceSections.reusableMachinery: Stored executor/result/scoring/footprint/persistence machinery associated with linked runtime contracts.
faceSections.history: Stored Founder decisions, repairs, and approval evidence tied by runtime ID or canonical face hash.
faceSections.executionState: Mechanical contract/binding/lifecycle state. It is not a semantic inheritance grade.
faceSections.provenance: Exact source references for the face record.

sentinels.UNKNOWN: A required identity/result cannot be resolved from stored evidence.
sentinels.NOT_STORED: The source has no stored value for the field.

canonicalFaceResolutionValues.ONE_REGISTERED_CANONICAL_FACE: All matched runtime identities share one stored registration asset SHA-256.
canonicalFaceResolutionValues.MULTIPLE_REGISTERED_CANONICAL_FACES: The census row mechanically matches runtime identities with more than one registration asset SHA-256; no face was selected.
canonicalFaceResolutionValues.NO_REGISTERED_RUNTIME_BINDING: No exact QT identity, SKU/product token, or exact normalized product-name binding was found.

matchMethods.exact_sku_or_product_id_token: Exact normalized token equality against stored SKU/product ID.
matchMethods.exact_normalized_product_name: Exact normalized product-name equality, used only when no token match exists.

nonGoals: No inference of missing regions, rules, values, or authority.
